name: Resolution 8
definition: Resolutions at the agenda of a meeting and type of resolution.

IssuerLabel.name: Issuer Label
IssuerLabel.definition: Number of the resolution as specified by the issuer or its agent.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Language, title and textual description of an agenda resolution.

ListingGroupResolutionLabel.name: Listing Group Resolution Label
ListingGroupResolutionLabel.definition: Identifies under the same label a group of agenda resolutions for which a vote in favour can be assigned to only one resolution of that group.

ForInformationOnly.name: For Information Only
ForInformationOnly.definition: Indicates whether the resolution is listed for information or for voting.

VoteType.name: Vote Type
VoteType.definition: Impact of vote results on an agenda resolution.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies whether the resolution is active or withdrawn.

SubmittedBySecurityHolder.name: Submitted By Security Holder
SubmittedBySecurityHolder.definition: Indicates whether the resolution has been submitted by the security holder.

RightToWithdrawIndicator.name: Right To Withdraw Indicator
RightToWithdrawIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a client who has not voted in favour of the resolutions which is finally approved, has the right to withdraw from a related corporate action event.

VoteInstructionType.name: Vote Instruction Type
VoteInstructionType.definition: Vote options allowed at the resolution level. When specified, it supersedes the vote options given for the meeting.

ManagementRecommendation.name: Management Recommendation
ManagementRecommendation.definition: Specifies how the management of the issuing company wishes the security holders to vote.

NotifyingPartyRecommendation.name: Notifying Party Recommendation
NotifyingPartyRecommendation.definition: Specifies how the notifying party recommends that the security holders vote.

Entitlement.name: Entitlement
Entitlement.definition: Number of votes assigned per resolution to one security.

VotingRightsThresholdForApproval.name: Voting Rights Threshold For Approval
VotingRightsThresholdForApproval.definition: Voting rights threshold and threshold basis to have a meeting resolution approved.

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Address to use over the www (HTTP) service where specific additional information on meeting resolutions may be found.

VotingRightsTresholdForApproval1Rule.definition: If VotingRightThresholdForApproval is present more than once, then ThresholdBasis is mandatory in each occurrence of VotingRightThresholdForApproval and the value of the ThresholdBasis/Code element must be different in each occurrence.
